criteria.why: Two-group weights motivate a genuinely complete search rather than an unproved local rule.
criteria.naive: All 2^n allocations with fresh sums cost O(n2^n); carrying a sum removes repeated work.
criteria.observation: The complement has sum S−s; leaf difference is |S−2s|.
criteria.intuition: Define a call by the processed prefix and selected sum, then branch exclude/include.
criteria.worked_example: All eight leaves for [2,3,4] are shown in the actual call order, including complement symmetry.
criteria.correctness: Prefix-sum invariant; each selection bit sequence reaches exactly one subset leaf; minimizing over every leaf gives the optimum.
criteria.time_reasoning: Exact 2^(n+1)−1 calls, O(n+2^n) time, n=20 versus 40 scale.
criteria.space: Input and depth-n call stack; no simultaneous list of all subsets and no vector copy per call.
criteria.cpp_implementation: Explained base/branch/wrapper/main fragments precede and concatenate to the full C++17 program.
criteria.walkthrough: Explicit p=2,s=2 branch example and leaf table agree with code and sample.
criteria.edge_cases: Empty/zero/one/equal weights, odd total, n=20 and 64-bit intermediate bounds.
criteria.mistakes: Greedy 8,7,6,5,4 counterexample, shared-state leakage, symmetry versus asymptotic growth, unjustified pruning.
criteria.related: Complexity/recursion/bits/debugging canonical links, with recursion introduced before its use.
criteria.prerequisites: Basic functions and complexity; later backtracking practice is marked optional and prerequisite-dependent.
criteria.practice: All five old task identities retained; Stove added as optional actual-olympiad small-subtask progression.
criteria.priority: High tutorial importance; only Apple Division is core. Queens remains linked but becomes optional because it needs deeper backtracking. No global demotion of Queens.
criteria.checklist: Separates completeness explanation, implementation, independent solving and reading.
criteria.MN_quality: New natural MN prose; brute force introduced once, identifiers/math explained in context. Full English equivalent.
criteria.code_correctness: 99 independent reachable-sum-set cases, maximum sizes and sample; zero warnings.
criteria.working_links: Native topic/6 practice references resolve; Apple Division and Stove models checked against official sources.

criteria.why: Distinct-value counting motivates changing order without changing multiplicities.
criteria.naive: Earlier-position comparison sums to n(n−1)/2; contrast with a small O(n²) oracle.
criteria.observation: Monotonicity between equal endpoints forces all equal values into one block.
criteria.intuition: Merge sorted fronts, build singleton-to-doubled-width passes, then count block starts.
criteria.worked_example: Every pass for [5,2,5,1,2,−1,5] and all seven final-merge choices are shown.
criteria.correctness: Merge preserves sortedness and every occurrence; pass induction and block-start argument prove the complete result.
criteria.time_reasoning: n copies per pass and ceil(log2 n) passes; add scan/input phases rather than multiply.
criteria.space: One n-element buffer beyond input, no recursion, constant-time storage swap.
criteria.cpp_implementation: Actual merge/sort/count/main fragments precede the full C++17 implementation; explicit <algorithm> header for min.
criteria.walkthrough: First/second/output pointer roles and short-right-run handling match each actual loop.
criteria.edge_cases: 0/1, all equal, reverse, odd lengths, signed extremes and bounded index doubling.
criteria.mistakes: Source overwrite, dropped remainder, unsorted-neighbor count, final run bounds and lost original indices.
criteria.related: Recursion/top-down merge, binary search, prefix sums, two pointers; strict comparator and stability distinguished.
criteria.prerequisites: Arrays/loops/comparisons and complete-search foundation; all stored prerequisite IDs preserved.
criteria.practice: All six old identities retained, Stove added; one core Distinct Numbers. Median/two-pointer/exchange applications remain later extensions.
criteria.priority: High tutorial rationale; only direct core task promoted. Old lesson-core flags on Stick Lengths/Apartments become optional without changing their global priorities.
criteria.checklist: Requires both sortedness and multiset preservation, resource derivation and independent use.
criteria.MN_quality: Whole narrative newly written in MN, matching complete EN; no old appended-sections organization.
criteria.code_correctness: 97 count cases plus full sorted-vector oracle comparisons, including maximum-size inputs; zero warnings.
criteria.working_links: Native topic/7 practice cards resolve; official Distinct Numbers/Stove and primary C++ comparator contract checked.
